why.en: curl -i prints the status line and headers followed by the body, exactly the text the lesson shows.
why.hinglish: curl -i status line aur headers ke baad body print karta hai, bilkul wahi text jo lesson dikhata hai.

expect.en: A status line like HTTP/1.1 200 OK, headers such as Content-Type and Content-Length, a blank line, then HTML. Exact headers vary by time.
expect.hinglish: HTTP/1.1 200 OK jaisi status line, Content-Type aur Content-Length jaise headers, ek khaali line, phir HTML. Exact headers waqt ke saath badalte hain.

why.en: Ask for a page that does not exist and read only the headers.
why.hinglish: Ek aisa page maango jo exist nahi karta aur sirf headers padho.

expect.en: A first line with a 4xx status such as 404 Not Found. The exact code may vary by server.
expect.hinglish: Pehli line mein 404 Not Found jaisa 4xx status. Exact code server ke hisaab se alag ho sakta hai.

why.en: Many sites answer plain HTTP with a 301 and a Location header.
why.hinglish: Bahut si sites plain HTTP ka jawab 301 aur Location header se deti hain.

expect.en: A 301 (or similar 3xx) status and a Location: https://github.com/ header. Varies by site and over time.
expect.hinglish: 301 (ya milta-julta 3xx) status aur Location: https://github.com/ header. Site aur waqt ke hisaab se badal sakta hai.

title.en: Find requests and responses in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein requests aur responses dhoondo

why.en: Wireshark's http filter shows only the readable HTTP messages, hiding the TCP handshake.
why.hinglish: Wireshark ka http filter sirf padhne layak HTTP messages dikhata hai, TCP handshake chhupa deta hai.

expect.en: GET requests and 200 OK responses. Right-click one and choose Follow, TCP Stream to read the whole conversation as text.
expect.hinglish: GET requests aur 200 OK responses. Kisi par right-click karke Follow, TCP Stream chuno taaki poori baat text mein padh sako.
